errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to the 'Haupterwerb Kleinere' line. The actual line for 'Haupterwerb Kleinere' starts at approximately 22,000 Euro and ends at approximately 27,000 Euro. The values provided in the description (starting at ~34,000 Euro, ending at ~37,000 Euro) roughly correspond to the 'Haupterwerb Mittlere' line.

errors.evidence: This description for 'Haupterwerb Mittlere' is incorrect. It describes the line as 'dunkelblaue' (dark blue), which corresponds to 'Haupterwerb Größere'. Furthermore, the numerical values provided (starting at ~43,000 Euro, ending at ~50,000 Euro) do not match the 'Haupterwerb Mittlere' line, which actually starts at ~34,000 Euro and ends at ~38,000 Euro.
The line style for 'Haupterwerb Größere' is described as 'punktierte' (dotted), but it is clearly a dashed ('gestrichelte') line in the plot and legend.
